video.title: What is mlOps? MLOps explained simply in 60 seconds! #mlops

transcript.text: What is MLOps? MLOps is basically DevOps
for machine learning. In DevOps, you
automate building and deploying of
software. In MLOps, you automate
building, deploying and managing machine
learning models. This is how MLOps
actually work. First step is to version
control everything, your code, your
data, and machine learning models using
tools like MLflow. Doing this, we can
keep track of any changes happening in
the training data and we can also
retrain our models anytime we want.
Next, we will build pipelines to
automate all this process from training
a model to testing it and deploying it
without any manual work using tools like
CubeFlow. For deployment, you can
package your models into a Docker
container and run them on Kubernetes.
Once the model is live, you can also
monitor it using tools like Prometheus.
And finally, if you want to scale the
entire system, you can use cloud GPUs,
autoscaling or optimized infrastructure.
